title: Swag
slide_intent: Make identity legible at the scale of a person’s belongings while preserving the distinct jobs of wearable decoration and identification.
strategic_value: The brand colors and carrot can relate a shoe and a staff badge even though one is expressive and the other must identify its wearer.
demonstration: The left photograph pairs white shoes with orange soles and a small green mark. The dark badge on the right combines a carrot, name and portrait.
practical_value: Choose what needs to be read on the object. Use small color details on footwear and keep space for the person’s identity on a badge.

content_islands.name: Footwear photograph
content_islands.spec: Crop to the green trousers and white shoes, leaving the orange sole and small carrot detail visible.

content_islands.name: Badge photograph
content_islands.spec: Place a close crop of the clipped badge in the right half. Preserve the mark and name above the portrait.
